must: Preserve all six product routes and the original application fields.
Keep application preview messaging honest until a submission API exists.
Support keyboard focus and one-column mobile layouts.
avoid: Decorative card grids, glass effects, and placeholder actions.

decisions: Use Newsreader for editorial headlines and DM Sans for interface text.
Use warm paper, deep green, pale sage, and thin dividers; reserve dark panels for key decisions and featured stories.
Use photo-led introductions, a Radix workshop tab set, and a manual testimonial carousel to support specific reading tasks.
Use touch-sized carousel controls and a compact story index to avoid repeating full testimonial quotes.
Use locally stored stock photographs with source credits and keep application preview status explicit.
Present university marks and firm SVG wordmarks in spacious bordered logo grids adapted from 21st Logo Grid Cloud, with an institution non-endorsement note.
Use a compact B and slash mark in night green, paper, and sage for the favicon, header, footer, and touch icon.
Present the 12-course library as a filterable editorial index beside a selected course brief; keep plan pricing explicit per month.
Use Radix application dropdowns with grouped course choices, two-line option details, and the site's paper and sage palette.
